schema_note: schema 2 (2026-10-01) renames primary_A -> primary and fallback_B -> hedge and SWAPS which encoding each holds: the primary is now the NaN-outside file, because that is the encoding of the official template and of all 9 platform-scored group files. See reports/platform_encoding_evidence.json.
note_for_form: r13 lattice-s5 v2 20261001 | fault-blind every-5th-px grid, coverage baseline | local holdout 18/18 win, not a LB claim

primary.encoding: float32, NaN outside the survey footprint, GDAL_NODATA=nan, every footprint value finite and in [0, 1], LZW, no predictor -- the byte encoding of the official sample_submission.tif and of all 9 platform-scored group files

hedge.encoding: float32, 0.0 outside the footprint, no NoData tag, no NaN anywhere -- a hedge for a naive whole-array [0, 1] test; NOT the template's encoding
hedge.use: ONLY if the form rejects the primary

deviations_from_accepted_pattern: nodata None != 'nan' (all nine accepted files declare nan)
7111787 finite cells outside the footprint where the official template is NaN
hedge.label: hedge

source_artifact.recipe: R13-6 square lattice, stride 5, origin (0,0), footprint-masked

status.encoding_status: PRIMARY matches the encoding of the official template and of all 9 platform-scored group files (reports/platform_encoding_evidence.json)

limits: Verified locally with rasterio/GDAL, tifffile and Pillow against the official sample_submission.tif and the nine platform-scored group files. The DrivenData validator itself cannot be observed from here; acceptance is established only by the form's own response (reports/form_responses.json).
description: a fault-blind lattice (every 5th row and column, 4 % of the footprint). It is the repository's best local hold-out map under the frozen R13 rule (18/18 paired folds vs the R11 recipe) and it is a coverage-geometry baseline, not a geological prediction. It is NOT a predicted leaderboard score.
label: R13-6 fault-blind stride-5 lattice (holdout best)

alternates.label: R11-4 greedy marginal-precision recipe (second candidate)
alternates.note_for_form: r11 greedy-mp v2 20261001 | topo ridge 5% + 3 greedy blocks | local holdout win, not a LB claim
alternates.description: the R11 greedy marginal-precision recipe (topographic ridge 5 % plus three greedy blocks): the previous holdout best, a real map built from the geophysics/topography bands.

alternates.label: R14 prioritised union — geological prior with a coverage floor
alternates.note_for_form: r14 union 20261001 | along-strike tips 1% + stride-6 lattice to 4% total | fails predeclared gate D2/D3, experiment arm
alternates.description: a geological prior with a coverage floor: along-strike propagation ribbons grown from every tip of the full public fault catalogue (1 % of the footprint), then a fault-blind stride-6 lattice filling the remainder of a fixed 4 % total budget. It did NOT pass the predeclared R14 gate (it wins the new tip folds' worst-rule mean by +39 % over the shipped reference and loses the 15 pre-existing folds by 0.028, beyond the 0.002 allowance), so it is a listed experiment arm, not a recommendation, and not a predicted leaderboard score.

gate.verdict: does NOT pass the predeclared gate (D2 6/9, D3 loses 0.0279)

supersedes.reason: encoding roles were inverted: the zero-filled file was primary and the NaN-outside file was the fallback. Measurement shows the opposite: the NaN-outside encoding is the one the official template uses and the one all 9 platform-scored group files use; the only file the form ever rejected is the only one written with TIFF Predictor=2.
supersedes.alias_copies_not_archived: The four session-7 alias files (latest.tif/.zip, latest_nan.tif/.zip) were byte-identical to the A/B files archived under their real names; the duplicate alias copies were removed instead of archived twice. Recoverable from git history at commit ff76c37.
